body.isa: ARM, position independent, integer only (no VFP/NEON)
body.control_note: enable=0: both hooks only redo their two stock instructions. arena/arena_size: the installer writes an 8-aligned block (suggest 1-2 MiB of the sup block BSS, class-0 USER heap like every v3 sup block). max_entry: icons decoding larger than this are not cached.

veneers.layout: F8DF F000 (ldr.w pc,[pc,#0]) then body+entry (even = ARM)
veneers.placement: cave_alloc / cave.claim, 4-aligned, within +-16 MiB of the sites (cave arena is)

sites.name: h1
sites.returns_to: miss: C06021A0 (blx r2, stock decode) / hit: C060235A (ldr.w fp,[sp,#0x48])
sites.branch_targets_inside: none (checked: no branch in C0601F98 lands on the word or its 2nd half)
sites.power_off_restore: declare/claim as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES s4)

sites.name: h2
sites.branch_targets_inside: none (checked: no branch in C0601F98 lands on the word or its 2nd half)
sites.power_off_restore: declare/claim as a 4-byte section with orig_word (SUP_BUILD_RULES s4)

arm_order: patch h2, then h1 (each a single aligned word; C000E91C + C000EABC after each)
disarm_order: or restore h1 then h2 + cache maintenance
keep body and arena until reboot
firmware_calls_from_body: the UIC alloc [r6+0] (hit path, same args as stock)
context: DrawMgr (UIC image node load). Table edits mask IRQ/FIQ briefly; copies run with the entry pinned. A second task loading images concurrently only loses caching (pending key is tied to the frame sp).
behaviour_difference: only when the UIC allocator returns 0 on a hit: stock would decode into address 0; the hit path leaves [sp+0x48]=0 and the stock error path runs.
